# INFLUXYN

> INFLUXYN by YAGI Influx Solutions is a Colombo, Sri Lanka digital agency: web development, AI automation, video production, branding, UI/UX design, digital marketing and POS applications. Plans from Rs. 15,000 with free hosting and domain.

Home: https://influxyn.online/
Contact: yagiinfluxsolutions@gmail.com, +94 75 034 8396

## Services
- [Web Development](https://influxyn.online/services/web-development/): Fast, SEO-ready websites, e-commerce stores and web apps built with WordPress, WooCommerce, React and Firebase.
- [AI Automation](https://influxyn.online/services/ai-automation/): Chatbots, workflow automation and AI-assisted content that cut manual work and answer customers 24/7.
- [Video Production & Editing](https://influxyn.online/services/video-production/): Brand films, social reels, motion graphics and product demos edited and colour-graded for impact.
- [Branding & Identity](https://influxyn.online/services/branding/): Logos, colour systems, typography and brand guidelines that make your business memorable.
- [UI/UX Design](https://influxyn.online/services/ui-ux-design/): User research, wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces that keep customers coming back.
- [Digital Marketing](https://influxyn.online/services/digital-marketing/): SEO, social media, content and email marketing that bring qualified leads and measurable growth.
- [POS Applications](https://influxyn.online/services/pos-applications/): Custom point-of-sale software with inventory, sales analytics and multi-location control.
